hero.title: TONNANO
hero.intro: The first chapter begins before the first drop.

about.title: More Than A T-Shirt
about.p1: TONNANO is currently opening access to its founding members ahead of the official August Drop. Joining the whitelist is not simply reserving a garment — it is becoming part of the TONNANO story from day one.
about.p2: Every piece is designed with premium heavyweight cotton, refined construction and timeless design. Built around quality rather than quantity, created for those who appreciate craftsmanship and understated luxury.

drop.body: The first chapter of TONNANO begins with a carefully curated collection of premium oversized essentials. Every piece is produced in limited quantities. No restocks. No mass production.
drop.quote: Once sold out, this chapter will never return.

inner.title: Inner Code
cards: Each founding member receives a personalized inside label with their name alongside TONNANO branding.
Every order is delivered inside the official TONNANO presentation box.
Private drops, early access and members-only collections reserved for the Inner Code.
Become one of the first people shaping the TONNANO story from its very first chapter.

collection.title: Crafted In Detail
collection.body: Front, back, embroidery and inside label. Every garment studied like an object in a collection. Select a piece to view it closer.

whitelist.title: Join The Inner Code
whitelist.limit: Limited to the first 1,000 founding members.
whitelist.agree: I agree to receive exclusive updates from TONNANO.
whitelist.success: You are now part of the Inner Code. Your founding member status is reserved ahead of Drop 01.
whitelist.error: An error occurred. Please try again.

bilzerian.intro: A limited winter chapter shaped by Moroccan stone, cold air and the weight of considered materials. Ten silhouettes. One code.
bilzerian.story: BILZERIAN is the first TONNANO chapter built for winter. Heavyweight cotton, wool, technical shells and collector-grade details come together in a restrained uniform for the few.
bilzerian.gridNote: Ten limited silhouettes. Every piece is numbered by quantity, never reproduced.
bilzerian.craft: Nothing is added without reason. Fabrics are selected for weight, texture and the way they settle over time. Details stay close to the garment, discovered rather than announced.
bilzerian.accessCopy: The BILZERIAN chapter is reserved for Inner Code members. Request your place before the chapter closes.
